title: Changing a theme revalidates that one Space and nothing else

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail: Confirmed no rebuild is involved: site renders are anonymous ISR under the cross-request tag site:<slug>; lib/sites/editor/theme-revalidate.ts expires that one Space's tag and /sites tree (via refreshSite) when saveWebsiteStyle changes the look or theme. Publish already refreshes through the same seam.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
